evidences.evidence_quote: researchers have demonstrated the feasibility of using commodity RFID devices for through-wall eavesdropping [15, 17].
evidences.evidence_context: Many physiological features, e.g., respiration [9] and facial dynamics [35], and behavioral features, e.g., gait [36] and handshake [37], can be captured by RFID signals for human authentication and identification. In addition, researchers have demonstrated the feasibility of using commodity RFID devices for through-wall eavesdropping [15, 17]. Thus, it is crucial to implement privacy measures to secure RFID sensing systems.
